Bill.BriefDescription: Revising the agency council on coordinated transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the agency council on coordinatedtransportation; amending RCW 47.06B.901; and repealing RCW 47.06B.030and 47.06B.900.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 47.06B.030 (CouncilDuties) and 1999 c 385 s 5, 1999 c 372s 13, & 1998 c 173 s 3; and RCW 47.06B.900 (CouncilTermination) and 1999 c 385 s 7 & 1998c 173 s 6.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.06B.901 and 1999 c 385 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts, as now existing or hereafteramended, are each repealed, effective June 30, 2008: (1) RCW 47.06B.010 and 1999 c 385 § 1 & 1998 c 173 § 1; (2) RCW 47.06B.012 and 1999 c 385 § 2; (3) RCW 47.06B.015 and 1999 c 385 § 3; (4) RCW 47.06B.020 and ((1999 c 385 § 4 &)) 1998 c 173 § 2; and p. 1 SB 5337 (5) ((RCW 47.06B.030 and 1999 c 385 § 5 & 1998 c 173 § 3; and (6))) RCW 47.06B.040 and 1999 c 385 § 6.
